 Advertisement Early voting deadlines near in South Florida ahead of midterm elections
 Advertisement Updated: 6:56 PM EDT Oct 31, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Danielle Scruggs Allen Cone Assignment Editor Early voting deadlines near in South Florida ahead of midterm elections
 Updated: 6:56 PM EDT Oct 31, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Danielle Scruggs Allen Cone Assignment Editor , Fla. — Early voting deadlines are approaching this weekend across South Florida as the midterm elections draw closer.
 WPBF 25 Interactive Voter Guide for 2026 Florida general election 
 Advertisement Residents in Martin, St. Lucie, Indian River, and Okeechobee counties had until Saturday to cast their ballots at early polling locations. In Palm Beach County, early voting runs through Sunday with voters able to visit any of the 28 early polling sites.
 'On the Record': Florida 2026 gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds For those using mail-in ballots, the deadline to return them is Election Day, Nov. 3. Those ballots will be accepted during business hours Monday.
 More than 2.8 million of 13.7 million registered Floridians have already voted early, compared with over 50 million ballots cast nationwide ahead of Election Day. Also, around 1.8 million vote-by-mail ballots have been counted in Florida. 
 In Palm Beach County, nearly 178,000 people have submitted their ballots early. 
 'On the Record': Florida Democratic gubernatorial candidate David Jolly On the Treasure Coast, nearly 56,000 voters in St. Lucie County have already completed their ballots. In Martin and Indian River counties, around 29,000 have cast ballots early, while Okeechobee voters have submitted more than 3,700 ballots early.
